title: The Sunpaired Discipline
summary: The school course in raising a small sun in each palm and ending a fight with the school's joined zenith.

title: Manual of the Azure Dawn Guard
summary: The school manual of guarding with the first light of day so that one guard turns the blow and the next restores the guarded.

title: Sunwell and Rillgold Foundation Canon
summary: The school canon of filling a well of sun qi and letting it run out as a gold rill that heals and floods.

title: The Dual-Track Solar Crown
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of sun qi that meet at the crown in a single sky-filling blaze.

title: The Gale Daybreak Oath Discipline
summary: The school discipline of swearing the sun to a companion at daybreak and holding that oath through every blow.

title: Reckoning of the Steady Ray
summary: The school reckoning of drawing one steady ray through the air and striking along it so no blow strays.

title: The Gale-Sworn Noon Canon
summary: The school canon of the noon sun sworn to the wind that stands against every gale and answers it with a storm of light.

title: The Oath Beneath the Open Sun
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the sun's own heart and loosed from within as a rising eruption of light.
